description: This file declares constants, help text, and function signatures related to parsing touchpad configuration options for the Cuttlefish project. It includes functions to parse individual and multiple touchpad configurations from command-line arguments.

methods.name: ParseTouchpadConfig
methods.description: Parses a single touchpad configuration from a command-line flag string.

methods.name: ParseTouchpadConfigsFromArgs
methods.description: Parses multiple touchpad configurations from a list of command-line arguments.
